clauses.text: 1. Agreement Overview

source_location.excerpt: 1. Agreement Overview

clauses.text: This Pricing Table Agreement (“Agreement”) is entered into by and between Primevolta Hardware Solutions, having its principal office at [Vendor Address] (“Vendor”), and FinSecure Services, having its principal office at [Client Address] (“Client”).

source_location.excerpt: This Pricing Table Agreement (“Agreement”) is entered into by and between Primevolta Hardware Solutions, having its principal office at [Vendor Address] (“Vendor”), and FinSecure Services, having its principal office at [Client Address] (“Client”).

clauses.text: This Agreement defines the pricing, terms, and conditions applicable to the supply of electronic hardware products, accessories, and support services to Client. The purpose of this Agreement is to establish a clear, mutually agreed-upon pricing structure, including discounts, maintenance costs, and bulk order incentives.

clauses.text: Client shall pay 50% advance upon purchase order confirmation and the remaining 50% within 30 days after delivery and acceptance.
